question: Tamil is the ofﬁcial language of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Puducherry**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Part XVII of the Constitution of India deals with the official language.**

 
 
• ​It contains **Article 343 to Article 351.**
 
• It consists of the following chapters:
 

 
 
• **​Language of the Union**
 
• **Regional Languages**
 
• **Languages of the Supreme Court, High Court, etc.**
 
• **Special Directives**
